native_mechanisms: Lay the two symbol strings as crossed cords over a sand-tray so their crossings form a lattice of cells (the DP grid itself).

Wake a single one-cell-wide ink-worm that moves in eight directions and curls back over its own trail to re-test a junction from another face, keeping no ledger but the sand mounds (relax-and-revisit crawler with in-place best-value overwrite and no separate queue).
Let the worm cross a furrow sideways spending no sand, so one cord may slip a step ahead of the other at zero cost (free horizontal/gap transition).
core_technique: Score-bound-derived banded Needleman-Wunsch two-row DP, vectorised with AVX2 using an offset coordinate (G = H + 2j) so the left-gap dependency becomes a running/log-shift prefix maximum.
